title: Agent inserts a hidden functional backdoor in source code
bad_event: Agent inserts a hidden functional backdoor in source code
adversary: Untrusted agent with scenario-specific authority; full feasible action set requires specification.
refutation: A concrete executable trace produces the catalog bad event despite enforcing the candidate property: Enforce a narrower security-sensitive invariant: no changes to specified auth/crypto/egress surfaces without review; prove contract on restricted code
scope: Catalog-only draft. Origin: Apps, BigCodeBench, SWE-bench Django, LinuxArena. Feasibility estimate: M for restricted claim, L for all backdoors. Not a selected deployment.

assumptions.text: Complete reachable attacker actions and affected assets must be enumerated.
A trusted effect gate must enforce the relevant policy against every alternate path.
A frozen representative honest-task distribution and acceptance floor must be measured.
